title: A mutating command still says "now run slicer render" after --render already rendered
lead:
When a mutating command is passed `--render`, the `_mutating` wrapper renders and prints
`rendered N file(s)` — but the command body still prints its static "now run `slicer
render`" hint, so the output tells the user to do the step that just happened.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The `--render` flag exists precisely to fold the render step into the mutation. Printing
"now run `slicer render`" in the same run contradicts the `rendered N file(s)` line the
wrapper prints, and tells the user to repeat work slicer already did. Observed filing S50:
`slicer import s50.md --render` printed both `rendered 2 file(s)` and `now run
\`slicer render\``.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
`src/slicer/cli.py`. The static hints live in the command bodies, unaware of the flag: the
`_mutating` wrapper that does the rendering is at `cli.py:46`. Affected hints: `cmd_import`
at `cli.py:204` ("now run `slicer render`") and `cmd_prose_edit` at `cli.py:454` ("updated
{ref}; run `slicer render`"). `cmd_check`'s hint at `cli.py:555` is a different, correct
context and out of scope.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
`tests/test_cli.py` — with `--render`, the plain-text output of `import` (and prose `edit`)
does not contain "run `slicer render`"; without `--render`, it still does. `--json` output
is unchanged either way (the hint is a human-only line, not in the envelope).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Suppress the hint when the render will happen: only append the "now run `slicer render`"
line when `--render` was not passed (and not on `--dry-run`, which already takes its own
branch). Keep the guidance for the common no-flag case; drop it when the wrapper is about
to render. Consider a single small helper so both call sites stay in step, mirroring how
`_mutating` centralises the render itself.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
unittest suite green; from an installed build, `slicer import x.md --render` prints only
`rendered N file(s)` (no stale hint) while `slicer import x.md` still prints "now run
`slicer render`".

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
One commit.

**Not in this slice:** rewording the hint text itself, or adding render hints to commands
that do not currently print one; this only removes the contradiction when `--render` is
used. `cmd_check`'s "run `slicer render` and `slicer sync`" message is a separate,
correct context and is left alone.
